limitations: The universal signed common content is a lower bound, not an exact primitive content calculation.
No weight-four 30.83 arithmetic or 31.614437 real constant is carried into s>=5.
The repaired layouts need their own quantitative archimedean energy and arithmetic summation.
The original triple-zero layout has a nonzero finite crossing correction from s=5 onward.
No peer numerical optimization output is used or rerun in this proof.
